## getItemChildrenList

<a id="opIdgetItemChildrenList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/items/string/children \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /items/{id}/children`

Returns the List of child summary items under an item.

If the item is a Season then the children will be episodes and ordered by episode number.

If the item is a Show then the children will be Seasons and ordered by season number.

Returns 404 if no children found.


<h3 id="getitemchildrenlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The identifier of the item whose children to load.|
|page|query|integer(int32)|false|The page of items to load. Starts from page 1.|
|page_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of items to return in a page.|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of items returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|order|query|string|false|The list sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|

## getItemRelatedList

<a id="opIdgetItemRelatedList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/items/string/related \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /items/{id}/related`

Returns the list of items related to the parent item.

Note for now, due to the size of the list being unknown, only a single page will be returned.


<h3 id="getitemrelatedlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The identifier of the item to based related items off.|
|page|query|integer(int32)|false|The page of items to load. Starts from page 1.|
|page_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of items to return in a page.|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of items returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

## getPublicItemMediaFiles

<a id="opIdgetPublicItemMediaFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/items/string/videos?delivery=stream&resolution=HD-4K' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /items/{id}/videos`

Get the free / public video files associated with an item given maximum resolution,
device type and one or more delivery types.

Returns an array of video file objects which each include a url to a video.

The first entry in the array contains what is predicted to be the best match.
The remainder of the entries, if any, may contain resolutions below what was
requests. For example if you request HD-720 the response may also contain
SD entries.

If you specify multiple delivery types, then the response array will insert
types in the order you specify them in the query. For example `stream,progressive`
would return an array with 0 or more stream files followed by 0 or more progressive files.

If no files are found a 404 is returned.


<h3 id="getpublicitemmediafiles-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The identifier of the item whose video files to load.|
|delivery|query|[string]|true|The video delivery type you require.|
|resolution|query|string|true|The maximum resolution the device to playback the media can present.|
|formats|query|[string]|false|The set of media file formats that the device supports, in the order of preference.<br><br>When provided, Rocket API returns only media files in formats specified in this parameter. For each resolution, only the first media file of matching supported format is returned. Files of different resolutions may be of different supported media file formats.<br><br>`external` value is reserved for project customizations where the real MIME type of the file on the specified URL is unknown at the time of ingestion.<br><br>When not provided, Rocket API uses the legacy `User-Agent` header-based logic to find matching media files.<br>|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|delivery|stream|
|delivery|progressive|
|delivery|download|
|resolution|HD-4K|
|resolution|HD-1080|
|resolution|HD-720|
|resolution|SD|
|resolution|External|
|formats|mp4|
|formats|mpd|
|formats|hls|
|formats|external|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

## getAnonNextPlaybackItem

<a id="opIdgetAnonNextPlaybackItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/items/string/next \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /items/{itemId}/next`

Identical to GET /account/profile/items/{itemId}/next route but for users
that are not logged in i.e. this endpoint does not require authorisation


<h3 id="getanonnextplaybackitem-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string|true|The identifier of the source item to base the next to watch item off.<br>|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of an item returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|expand|query|string|false|If no value is specified no dependencies are expanded.<br><br>If 'parent' is specified then only the direct parent will be expanded.<br>For example if an `Episode` then the `Season` would be included.<br><br>If 'ancestors' is specified then the full parent chain is expanded.<br>For example if an `Episode` then both the `Season` and `Show` would be included.<br>|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|parent|
|expand|ancestors|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

## getItemsMediaClipFiles

<a id="opIdgetItemsMediaClipFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/itv/items/clips \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "ids": "1234,2345,3456"
  }'
```

`POST /itv/items/clips`

Get the media clip files associated with items.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ids": "1234,2345,3456"
}
```

<h3 id="getitemsmediaclipfiles-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|body|body|[ItemDownloadableRequest](#schemaitemdownloadablerequest)|true|The item Axis ids joined string with comma.|
|» ids|body|string|true|Comma-separated list of AXIS item ids.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

> 200 Response

    {
      "clips": [
        {
          "channels": 0,

          "name": "string",

## getLists

<a id="opIdgetLists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/lists?ids=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /lists`

Returns an array of item lists with their first page of content resolved.

<h3 id="getlists-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ids|query|[string]|true|A comma delimited list of item list identifiers.<br><br>These can be list ids e.g. `14354,65473,3234`<br><br>Or more complex sort/filter queries using pipes e.g.<br><br>`14354\|max_rating=AUOFLC-E\|order=asc\|order_by=year-added,65473\|page_size=30,3234`<br><br>_Note the id must always come first for each encoded list query_<br><br>List parameters may be provide without the `param=` prefix e.g. `14354\|genre:action`<br><br>Only the following options can be present.<br>  - `order`<br>  - `order_by`<br>  - `max_rating`<br>  - `page_size`<br>  - `item_type`<br>  - `param`<br>|
|page_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of items to return in a page.|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of items returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|order|query|string|false|The list sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'.|
|order_by|query|string|false|What to order by.|
|item_type|query|string|false|The item type to filter by. Defaults to unspecified.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

## getList

<a id="opIdgetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/lists/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /lists/{id}`

Returns a list of items under the specified item list

<h3 id="getlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The identifier of the list to load.|
|page|query|integer(int32)|false|The page of items to load. Starts from page 1.|
|page_size|query|integer(int32)|false|The number of items to return in a page.|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of items returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|order|query|string|false|The list sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'.|
|order_by|query|string|false|What to order by.|
|param|query|string|false|The list parameter in format 'key:value', e.g. 'genre:action'.|
|item_type|query|string|false|The item type to filter by. Defaults to unspecified.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order|asc|
|order|desc|
|order_by|a-z|
|order_by|release-year|
|order_by|date-added|
|item_type|movie|
|item_type|show|
|item_type|season|
|item_type|episode|
|item_type|program|
|item_type|link|
|item_type|trailer|
|item_type|channel|
|item_type|customAsset|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

## get/plans/{id}

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/plans/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /plans/{id}`

Returns the details of a Plan with the specified id.

<h3 id="getplansid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The identifier of the Plan to load.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

## getSchedules

<a id="opIdgetSchedules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/schedules?channels=string&date=1970-01-01&hour=0&duration=-24' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /schedules`

Returns schedules for a defined set of channels over a requested period.

Schedules are requested in hour blocks and returned grouped by the channel
they belong to.

For example, to load 12 hours of schedules for channels `4343` and `5234`,
on 21/2/2017 starting from 08:00.

```
channels=4343,5234
date=2017-02-21
hour=8
duration=12
```

Please remember that `date` and `hour` combined represent a normal datetime, 
so they should be converted to UTC on the client - this will help to avoid 
issues with EPG schedules near midnight.

If a channel id is passed which doesn't exist then this endpoint will
return an empty schedule list for it. If instead we returned 404,
this would invalidate all other channel schedules in the same request
which would be unfriendly for clients presenting these channel schedules.


<h3 id="getschedules-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channels|query|[string]|true|The list of channel ids to get schedules for.|
|date|query|string(date)|true|The date to target in ISO format, e.g. `2017-05-23` (converted to UTC - see main description).<br><br>The base hour requested will belong to this date.<br>|
|hour|query|integer(int32)|true|The base hour in the day, defined by the `date` parameter, you wish to load schedules for <br>(converted to UTC - see main description).<br><br>From 0 to 23, where 0 is midnight.<br>|
|duration|query|integer(int32)|true|The number of hours of schedules to load from the base `hour` parameter.<br><br>This may be negative or positive depending on whether you want to load past or future schedules.<br><br>Minimum value is -24, maximum is 24. A value of zero is invalid.<br>|
|intersect|query|boolean|false|Flag indicating whether schedules should intersect or be contained in the<br>provided interval.<br><br>If set to `true`, the result will contain all schedules where either<br>schedule start time or end time touches the provided interval.<br><br>If set to `false`, only schedules fully contained in the given period<br>will be returned.<br>|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

<h3 id="getschedules-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An array of schedule lists for each channel requested.<br><br>The order of the channels will match the order of channel ids passed during the request.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|404|Not Found|Not found.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Unsupported Media Type|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|default|Default|Service error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|

<h3 id="getschedules-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ItemScheduleList](#schemaitemschedulelist)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## search

<a id="opIdsearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/search?term=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /search`

Search the catalog of items and people.

<h3 id="search-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|term|query|string|true|The search term to query.|
|include|query|[string]|false|By default people, movies and tv (shows + programs) will be included<br>in the search results.<br><br>If the `cas` feature flag is set, "other" items (`customAsset`s) will<br>also be included by default<br><br>If you don't want all of these types you can specifiy the specific<br>includes you care about.<br>|
|group|query|boolean|false|When this option is set, instead of all search result items being returned<br>in a single list, they will instead be returned under two lists. One for<br>movies and another for tv (shows + programs).<br><br>if the `cas` feature flag is set, a third `other` list will be<br>included containing `customAsset` results<br><br>Default is undefined meaning items will be returned in a single list.<br><br>The array of `people` results will always be separate from items.<br>|
|max_results|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of results to return.|
|max_rating|query|string|false|The maximum rating (inclusive) of items returned, e.g. 'auoflc-pg'.|
|device|query|string|false|The type of device the content is targeting.|
|sub|query|string|false|The active subscription code.|
|segments|query|[string]|false|The list of segments to filter the response by.|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|include|tv|
|include|movies|
|include|people|
|include|other|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

<a id="opIdgetAccountTokenWithPin"></a>

curl https://example.com/itv/pinauthorization \

    ]
  }'

`POST /itv/pinauthorization`

Provides authorization with parental control pin.

Returns an array containing account token with Playback scope.

Requires access token with Catalog scope.

Pin must be a 4-digit string

```json

  "cookieType": "Session",
  "pin": "string",
  "scopes": [
    "Catalog"
  ]
}

Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|body|body|[ItvPinAuthRequest](#schemaitvpinauthrequest)|true|Details of token request.|
|» cookieType|body|string|false|If you specify a cookie type then a content filter cookie will be returned<br>along with the token(s). This is only intended for web based clients which<br>need to pass the cookies to a server to render a page based on the user's<br>content filters e.g subscription code.<br><br>If type `Session` the cookie will be session based.<br>If type `Persistent` the cookie will have a medium term lifespan.<br>If undefined no cookies will be set.<br>|
|» pin|body|string|true|The 4-digit parental control pin.|
|» scopes|body|[string]|false|The scope(s) of the token(s) required.|

## getItvProfileToken

<a id="opIdgetItvProfileToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/itv/profiletoken \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "password": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /itv/profiletoken`

Returns the ITV profile token.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "password": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="getitvprofiletoken-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|body|body|[ItvProfileTokenRequest](#schemaitvprofiletokenrequest)|true|Details of token request.|
|» password|body|string|true|The password.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "profileToken": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="getitvprofiletoken-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The ITV profile token.|[ItvProfileToken](#schemaitvprofiletoken)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|404|Not Found|Not found.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Unsupported Media Type|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|default|Default|Service error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
accountAuth ( Scopes: Catalog )
</aside>

## getCurrentSubscription

<a id="opIdgetCurrentSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/itv/purchase/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /itv/purchase/{platform}`

Returns the details of current subscription for specified payment platform.

<h3 id="getcurrentsubscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|platform|path|string|true|The identifier of the payment platform (stripe/itunes).|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "cancelAtPeriodEnd": true,
  "collectionMethod": "string",
  "created": 0,
  "currentPeriodEnd": 0,
  "currentPeriodStart": 0,
  "plan": {},
  "status": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="getcurrentsubscription-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Details of current subscription.|[ItvCurrentSubscription](#schemaitvcurrentsubscription)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|404|Not Found|Not found.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Unsupported Media Type|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|
|default|Default|Service error.|[ServiceError](#schemaserviceerror)|

accountAuth ( Scopes: Catalog )

## confirmPurchase

<a id="opIdconfirmPurchase"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/itv/purchase/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "cardToken": "string",
    "planId": "string",
    "profileToken": "string",
    "voucher": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /itv/purchase/{platform}`

Confirms purchase and returns the details of purchased subscription for specified payment platform.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cardToken": "string",
  "planId": "string",
  "profileToken": "string",
  "voucher": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="confirmpurchase-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|platform|path|string|true|The identifier of the payment platform (stripe/itunes).|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|body|body|[ItvPurchaseRequest](#schemaitvpurchaserequest)|true|Details of a purchase request.|
|» cardToken|body|string|true|The credit card token.|
|» planId|body|string|true|The identifier of the plan to purchase.|
|» profileToken|body|string|true|The ITV profile token.|
|» voucher|body|string|false|A coupon/voucher for a discount.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "customerId": "string",
  "planId": "string",
  "subscriptionId": "string"
}
```

<h1 id="rocket-services-registration">registration</h1>

## register

<a id="opIdregister"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/register \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "email": "string",
    "firstName": "string",
    "languageCode": "string",
    "lastName": "string",
    "marketing": true,
    "password": "string",
    "pin": "string",
    "segments": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /register`

Register a new user, creating them an account.

Registration, when successful, will return an array of access tokens so the user is
immediately signed in.

It returns Catalog and Commerce scoped tokens for both Account and Profile.
The Commerce ones are intended to allow the purchase of a subscription plan
in the step after registration, without the user being prompted to enter
their username and password again.

An email will also be sent with a link they need to click to confirm their
email address. This confirmation is done via the /verify-email endpoint.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "string",
  "firstName": "string",
  "languageCode": "string",
  "lastName": "string",
  "marketing": true,
  "password": "string",
  "pin": "string",
  "segments": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="register-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ff|query|[string]|false|The set of opt in feature flags which cause breaking changes to responses.<br><br>While Rocket APIs look to avoid breaking changes under the active major version, the formats of responses<br>may need to evolve over this time.<br><br>These feature flags allow clients to select which response formats they expect and avoid breaking<br>clients as these formats evolve under the current major version.<br><br>### Flags<br><br>- `all` - Enable all flags. Useful for testing. _Don't use in production_.<br>- `idp` - Dynamic item detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `ldp` - Dynamic list detail pages with schedulable rows.<br>- `hb` - Hubble formatted image urls.<br>- `rpt` - Updated resume point threshold logic.<br>- `cas` - "Custom Asset Search", inlcude `customAssets` in search results.<br>- `lrl` - Do not pre-populate related list if more than `max_list_prefetch` down the page.<br>- `cd` - Custom Destination support.<br><br>See the `feature-flags.md` for available flag details.<br>|
|lang|query|string|false|Language code for the preferred language to be returned in the response.<br><br>Parameter value is case-insensitive and should be<br>  - a valid 2 letter language code without region such as en, de<br>  - or with region such as en_us, en_au<br><br>If undefined then defaults to 'en', unless the server has been configured<br>with a custom default.<br><br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|body|body|[RegistrationRequest](#schemaregistrationrequest)|true|Registration details.|
|» email|body|string|true|none|
|» firstName|body|string|false|none|
|» languageCode|body|string|false|The code of the preferred language for the primary profile.<br>Must be a valid ISO language code e.g. "en-US" and must match the code of<br>one of the languages specified in the app config.<br>See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes<br>|
|» lastName|body|string|false|none|
|» marketing|body|boolean|false|Whether to receive marketing material or not. Default to true.|
|» password|body|string|true|none|
|» pin|body|string|false|The primary account pin.|
|» segments|body|[string]|false|The segments to apply to the primary profile.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|ff|all|
|ff|idp|
|ff|ldp|
|ff|hb|
|ff|rpt|
|ff|cas|
|ff|lrl|
|ff|cd|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "accountCreated": true,
    "expirationDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "refreshable": true,
    "type": "UserAccount",
    "value": "string"
  }
]
```

}
```

```

}

|refreshable|boolean|true|none|True if this token can be refreshed, false if not.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the token.|
|value|string|true|none|The token value used for authenticated requests.|

|defaultPaymentInstrumentId|string|false|none|The id of the payment instrument to use by default for account transactions.<br><br> **DEPRECATED** The property `defaultPaymentMethodId` is now preferred.<br>|
|defaultPaymentMethodId|string|false|none|The id of the payment method to use by default for account transactions.|
|emailVerified|boolean|false|none|Whether the email address has been verified.<br><br>Users who receive an emailed verification url click the link to verify their email address.<br>|
|entitlements|[[Entitlement](#schemaentitlement)]|false|none|The list of entitlements to playback specific items.|
|firstName|string|false|none|The first name of the account holder.|
|id|string|true|none|The id of the account.|
|isFirstTimeSubscriber|boolean|false|none|Whether the account has the very first subscription.|
|lastName|string|false|none|The last name of the account holder.|
|marketingEnabled|boolean|true|none|Whether the account has opted in or out of marketing material.|
|minRatingPlaybackGuard|string|false|none|The classification rating defining the minimum rating level a user should be<br>forced to enter the account pin code for playback. Anything at this rating<br>level or above will require the pin for playback.<br><br>e.g. AUOFLC-MA15+<br><br>If you want to disable this guard pass an empty string or `null`.<br>|
|pinEnabled|boolean|true|none|When an account level pin is defined this will be true.|
|primaryProfileId|string|true|none|The id of the primary profile.|
|profiles|[[ProfileSummary](#schemaprofilesummary)]|true|none|The list of profiles under this account.|
|segments|[string]|false|none|The segments an account has been placed under|
|subscriptionCode|string|true|none|The active subscription code for an account.<br><br>The value of this should be passed to any endpoints accepting a `sub` query parameter.<br>|
|subscriptions|[[Subscription](#schemasubscription)]|false|none|The list of subscriptions, if any, the account has signed up to.|
|trackingEnabled|boolean|true|none|Whether usage tracking is associated with the account or anonymous.|
|usedFreeTrial|boolean|false|none|Whether the account has used up their free trial period of a plan.|

  ]
}

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cookieType|string|false|none|If you specify a cookie type then a content filter cookie will be returned<br>along with the token(s). This is only intended for web based clients which<br>need to pass the cookies to a server to render a page based on the user's<br>content filters e.g subscription code.<br><br>If type `Session` the cookie will be session based.<br>If type `Persistent` the cookie will have a medium term lifespan.<br>If undefined no cookies will be set.<br>|
|email|string|true|none|The email associated with the account.|
|password|string|true|none|The password associated with the account.|
|scopes|[string]|true|none|The scope(s) of the tokens required.<br>For each scope listed an Account and Profile token of that scope will be returned<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|cookieType|Session|
|cookieType|Persistent|
|scopes|Catalog|
|scopes|Commerce|
|scopes|Settings|
|scopes|Playback|

<h2 id="tocS_AppConfigPlayback">AppConfigPlayback</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaappconfigplayback"></a>
<a id="schema_AppConfigPlayback"></a>
<a id="tocSappconfigplayback"></a>
<a id="tocsappconfigplayback"></a>

```json
{
  "chainPlayCountdown": 0,
  "chainPlaySqueezeback": 0,
  "chainPlayTimeout": 0,
  "heartbeatFrequency": 0,
  "viewEventPoints": [
    0
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chainPlayCountdown|integer(int32)|true|none|The number of seconds before autoplay of next video.<br><br>If set to 0 there will be no autoplay.<br>|
|chainPlaySqueezeback|integer(int32)|true|none|The number of seconds before the end of playback when the current video<br>should be minimized and user options are presented within the video player.<br><br>If set to 0 there will be no squeezeback.<br>|
|chainPlayTimeout|integer(int32)|true|none|The number of minutes of user inactivity before autoplay is paused.<br><br>If set to 0 there will be no autoplay timeout.<br>|
|heartbeatFrequency|integer(int32)|true|none|How often a heartbeat should be renewed during playback.|
|viewEventPoints|[number]|true|none|An array of percentage points in which to fire off plabyack view events.<br>For example a value of 0.5 would indicate that an event should be<br>fired when the user is half way through the video.<br>Often known as quartiles when four equaly spread event points.<br>|

List data for ContinueWatching List

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemInclusions|object|false|none|Object where keys are itemIds for the items in the list and values are objects<br>containing additional items (either episode/season/show) that were requested<br>in the "include" query option.<br><br>For example if you request the ContinueWatching list with "season" items in<br>the list, you can specify `include=episode` and then the specific next episode<br>will be returned in this object.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_Credit">Credit</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacredit"></a>
<a id="schema_Credit"></a>
<a id="tocScredit"></a>
<a id="tocscredit"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "path": "string",
  "character": "string",
  "role": "actor"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the person.|
|path|string|true|none|The path to the person|
|character|string|false|none|The name of the character.|
|role|string|true|none|The type of role the credit performed, e.g. actor.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|role|actor|
|role|associateproducer|
|role|coactor|
|role|director|
|role|executiveproducer|
|role|filminglocation|
|role|guest|
|role|narrator|
|role|other|
|role|presenter|
|role|producer|
|role|productmanager|
|role|thememusicby|
|role|voice|
|role|writer|

<h2 id="tocS_DeviceRegistrationWindow">DeviceRegistrationWindow</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemadeviceregistrationwindow"></a>
<a id="schema_DeviceRegistrationWindow"></a>
<a id="tocSdeviceregistrationwindow"></a>
<a id="tocsdeviceregistrationwindow"></a>

```json
{
  "endDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "limit": 0,
  "periodDays": 0,
  "remaining": 0,
  "startDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|endDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The end date of the current period.<br><br>This is based on the value of `startDate` plus the number of days defined by  `periodDays`.<br>|
|limit|integer(int32)|true|none|The maximum de/registrations that can be made in a period.|
|periodDays|integer(int32)|true|none|The number of days a de/registration period runs for.|
|remaining|integer(int32)|true|none|The remaining de/registrations that can be made in the current period.|
|startDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The start date of the current period.<br><br>This is based on the earliest device de/registrations in the past N days, where<br>N is defined by `periodDays`.<br><br>If no device has been de/registered then start date will be from the current date.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advisoryText|string|false|none|Advisory text about this item, related to the classification|
|availableEpisodeCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of available episodes in the season, if the item is a season.|
|availableSeasonCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of available seasons in the show, if the item is a show.|
|averageUserRating|number(int32)|false|none|The average user rating.<br>When based on user ratings from our system this will be out of 10.<br>|
|badge|string|false|none|The badge this item has.|
|channelShortCode|string|false|none|The channel short code, if the item is a channel.|
|classification|[ClassificationSummary](#schemaclassificationsummary)|false|none|none|
|contextualTitle|string|false|none|A contextually relative title to display after a parent title.<br>Mostly applicable to Season, Episode and Trailer.<br>|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for an item.|
|customId|string|false|none|A custom identifier for this item.<br>For example the id for this item under a different content system.<br>|
|duration|integer(int32)|false|none|The duration of the media in seconds.|
|episodeCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of episodes in the season, if the item is a season.|
|episodeName|string|false|none|The full name of an episode.|
|episodeNumber|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of an episode, if the item is an episode.|
|genres|[string]|false|none|The array of genres this item belongs to.|
|hasClosedCaptions|boolean|false|none|Whether closed captioning is available.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for an Item|
|images|object|false|none|none|
|offers|[[Offer](#schemaoffer)]|false|none|The array of available offers for this item.|
|path|string|true|none|The path to the detail page of this item. Can be used to load the item detail page via the /page endpoint.|
|releaseYear|integer(int32)|false|none|The year this item was released|
|scopes|[string]|false|none|The scopes for this item|
|seasonId|string|false|none|The identifier of the season this item belongs to, if the item is an episode.|
|seasonNumber|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of a season, if the item is a season.|
|shortDescription|string|false|none|A truncated description of the item|
|showId|string|false|none|The identifier of the show this item belongs to, if the item is a season or episode.|
|showTitle|string|false|none|none|
|subtype|string|false|none|Subtype of the item. Mainly used to identify different types when `type`<br>is `customAsset`<br>|
|tagline|string|false|none|The tagline of the item|
|themes|[[Theme](#schematheme)]|false|none|Gets themes associated with the item|
|title|string|true|none|The display title of the item.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of item|
|watchPath|string|false|none|The path to watch this item, if the item is a watchable type, e.g. a `movie`, `program` and `episode`.|
|copyright|string|false|none|Copyright information about this item|
|credits|[[Credit](#schemacredit)]|false|none|A list of credits associated with this item.|
|customMetadata|[[ItemCustomMetadata](#schemaitemcustommetadata)]|false|none|An ordered list of custom name-value-pair item metadata.<br><br>Usually displayed on an item detail page.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|The description of this item.|
|distributor|string|false|none|The distributor of this item.|
|episodes|[ItemList](#schemaitemlist)|false|none|A pageable list of items.|
|eventDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The optional date of an event.<br>Specific to a Program item type.<br>|
|genrePaths|[string]|false|none|An array of genre paths mapping to the values within the `genres` array from ItemSummary.<br>|
|location|string|false|none|The optional location (e.g. city) of an event.<br>Specific to a Program item type.<br>|
|season|[ItemDetail](#schemaitemdetail)|false|none|none|
|seasons|[ItemList](#schemaitemlist)|false|none|A pageable list of items.|
|show|[ItemDetail](#schemaitemdetail)|false|none|none|
|totalUserRatings|integer(int32)|false|none|The total number of users who have rated this item.|
|trailers|[[ItemSummary](#schemaitemsummary)]|false|none|A list of trailers associated with this item.|
|venue|string|false|none|The optional venue of an event.<br>Specific to a Program item type.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|movie|
|type|show|
|type|season|
|type|episode|
|type|program|
|type|link|
|type|trailer|
|type|channel|
|type|customAsset|

A pageable list of items.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for a list.|
|description|string|false|none|A full description of this list.|
|id|string|true|none|The id of this list|
|images|object|false|none|none|
|itemTypes|[string]|false|none|The types of items in the list|
|items|[[ItemSummary](#schemaitemsummary)]|true|none|A list of items|
|listData|[ListData](#schemalistdata)|false|none|Extra data to accompany ItemList content. The (single) key in the object is<br>the list name and the data changes depending on the list<br>|
|paging|[Pagination](#schemapagination)|true|none|none|
|parameter|string|false|none|If this list is parameterized, then this contains the parameter of the list in the format `name:value`.<br>For example the Movies Genre list will take a parameter `genre` with a given value. e.g. `genre:action` or `genre:drama`.|
|path|string|true|none|The path of this list|
|shortDescription|string|false|none|A short description of this list.|
|size|integer(int32)|true|none|The total size of the list|
|tagline|string|false|none|The tagline of the item.|
|themes|[[Theme](#schematheme)]|false|none|none|
|title|string|false|none|The title of this list|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|itemTypes|movie|
|itemTypes|show|
|itemTypes|season|
|itemTypes|episode|
|itemTypes|program|
|itemTypes|link|
|itemTypes|trailer|
|itemTypes|channel|
|itemTypes|customAsset|

<h2 id="tocS_ItemSchedule">ItemSchedule</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaitemschedule"></a>
<a id="schema_ItemSchedule"></a>
<a id="tocSitemschedule"></a>
<a id="tocsitemschedule"></a>

```json
{
  "blackout": true,
  "channelId": "string",
  "endDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "featured": true,
  "id": "string",
  "live": true,
  "repeat": true,
  "startDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|blackout|boolean|false|none|True if this schedule represents time when the channel is completely off air.|
|channelId|string|true|none|The id of the channel item this schedule belongs to.|
|endDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time this schedule ends.|
|featured|boolean|false|none|True if this is a featured item schedule.|
|id|string|true|none|none|
|live|boolean|false|none|True if this is a live event.|
|repeat|boolean|false|none|True if this has been aired previously on the same channel.|
|startDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time this schedule starts.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advisoryText|string|false|none|Advisory text about this item, related to the classification|
|availableEpisodeCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of available episodes in the season, if the item is a season.|
|availableSeasonCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of available seasons in the show, if the item is a show.|
|averageUserRating|number(int32)|false|none|The average user rating.<br>When based on user ratings from our system this will be out of 10.<br>|
|badge|string|false|none|The badge this item has.|
|channelShortCode|string|false|none|The channel short code, if the item is a channel.|
|classification|[ClassificationSummary](#schemaclassificationsummary)|false|none|none|
|contextualTitle|string|false|none|A contextually relative title to display after a parent title.<br>Mostly applicable to Season, Episode and Trailer.<br>|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for an item.|
|customId|string|false|none|A custom identifier for this item.<br>For example the id for this item under a different content system.<br>|
|duration|integer(int32)|false|none|The duration of the media in seconds.|
|episodeCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of episodes in the season, if the item is a season.|
|episodeName|string|false|none|The full name of an episode.|
|episodeNumber|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of an episode, if the item is an episode.|
|genres|[string]|false|none|The array of genres this item belongs to.|
|hasClosedCaptions|boolean|false|none|Whether closed captioning is available.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for an Item|
|images|object|false|none|none|
|offers|[[Offer](#schemaoffer)]|false|none|The array of available offers for this item.|
|path|string|true|none|The path to the detail page of this item. Can be used to load the item detail page via the /page endpoint.|
|releaseYear|integer(int32)|false|none|The year this item was released|
|scopes|[string]|false|none|The scopes for this item|
|seasonId|string|false|none|The identifier of the season this item belongs to, if the item is an episode.|
|seasonNumber|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of a season, if the item is a season.|
|shortDescription|string|false|none|A truncated description of the item|
|showId|string|false|none|The identifier of the show this item belongs to, if the item is a season or episode.|

<h2 id="tocS_MediaFile">MediaFile</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemamediafile"></a>
<a id="schema_MediaFile"></a>
<a id="tocSmediafile"></a>
<a id="tocsmediafile"></a>

```json
{
  "channels": 0,
  "deliveryType": "Stream",
  "drm": "string",
  "format": "string",
  "height": 0,
  "language": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "resolution": "SD",
  "url": "http://example.com",
  "width": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channels|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of audio channels.|
|deliveryType|string|true|none|The way in which the media file is delivered.|
|drm|string|true|none|The type of drm used to encrypt the media. 'None' if unencrypted.|
|format|string|true|none|The format the media was encoded in.|
|height|integer(int32)|true|none|The height of the video media.|
|language|string|true|none|The language code for the media, e.g. 'en'.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the media file.|
|resolution|string|true|none|The resolution of the video media.|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|The url to access the media file.|
|width|integer(int32)|true|none|The width of the video media.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|deliveryType|Stream|
|deliveryType|Progressive|
|deliveryType|Download|
|resolution|SD|
|resolution|HD-720|
|resolution|HD-1080|
|resolution|HD-4K|
|resolution|External|
|resolution|Unknown|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|children|[[NavEntry](#schemanaventry)]|false|none|Child nav entries.|
|content|[NavContent](#schemanavcontent)|false|none|none|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for a nav entry.|
|depth|integer(int32)|true|none|The depth of the NavEntry (top level is 0)|
|featured|boolean|false|none|True if this is a featured menu item.<br><br>Featured menu items may have a more prominent presentation than others in the navigation.<br>|
|icon|string|false|none|The icon for this nav entry.|
|label|string|false|none|The text label for this nav entry.|
|path|string|false|none|The path this nav entry links to.<br>May be undefined if the nav entry is not clickable e.g. a nav heading.<br>If the value begins with `http` then it's an external url.<br>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|firstWatchedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Time when the item corresponding to the itemId passed in by the client was<br>first watched by the user. Will be `undefined` if the user has never<br>watched the item.<br><br>It can be used to identify the scenario where the user has never watched a<br>show and we are suggesting they watch the first episode (i.e. it is<br>missing in this scenario)<br><br>**This will only be populated when a `showId` is passed in**<br>|
|lastWatchedDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Time when the item corresponding to the itemId passed in by the client was<br>last watched by the user. Will be `undefined` if the user has never<br>watched the item.<br><br>It can be used to identify the scenario where the user has never watched a<br>show and we are suggesting they watch the first episode (i.e. it is<br>missing in this scenario)<br><br>**This will only be populated when a `showId` is passed in**<br>|
|next|[ItemDetail](#schemaitemdetail)|false|none|none|
|sourceItemId|string|true|none|The id of the item used to determine the next item to play.|
|suggestionType|string|false|none|Field indicating the type or reason behind the suggestion.<br><br>Id Type   \| Show Watched Status\| Value            \| Description<br>----------\|--------------------\|------------------\|---------------------------------<br>showId    \| Unwatched          \| StartWatching    \|<br>showId    \| Completely watched \| RestartWatching  \|<br>showId    \| Partly watched     \| ContinueWatching \| Suggested episode partly watched<br>showId    \| Partly watched     \| Sequential       \| Suggested episode unwatched<br>episodeId \| Any                \| Sequential       \| Next episode in show<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|suggestionType|StartWatching|
|suggestionType|ContinueWatching|
|suggestionType|RestartWatching|
|suggestionType|Sequential|
|suggestionType|None|

<a id="tocSofferrights"></a>
<a id="tocsofferrights"></a>

```json
{
  "deliveryType": "Stream",
  "exclusionRules": [
    {
      "description": "string",
      "device": "string",
      "excludeAirplay": true,
      "excludeChromecast": true,
      "excludeDelivery": "Stream",
      "excludeMinResolution": "SD"
    }
  ],
  "maxDownloads": 0,
  "maxPlays": 0,
  "ownership": "Subscription",
  "playPeriod": 0,
  "rentalPeriod": 0,
  "resolution": "SD",
  "scopes": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

The base type for both Offer and Entitlement.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|deliveryType|string|true|none|none|
|exclusionRules|[[ExclusionRule](#schemaexclusionrule)]|false|none|Any specific playback exclusion rules.|
|maxDownloads|integer(int32)|false|none|The maximum number of allowed downloads.|
|maxPlays|integer(int32)|false|none|The maximum number of allowed plays.|
|ownership|string|true|none|none|
|playPeriod|integer(int32)|false|none|The length of time in minutes which the rental will last once played for the first time.|
|rentalPeriod|integer(int32)|false|none|The length of time in minutes which the rental will last once purchased.|
|resolution|string|true|none|none|
|scopes|[string]|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|deliveryType|Stream|
|deliveryType|Download|
|deliveryType|StreamOrDownload|
|deliveryType|ProgressiveDownload|
|deliveryType|None|
|ownership|Subscription|
|ownership|Free|
|ownership|Rent|
|ownership|Own|
|ownership|None|
|resolution|SD|
|resolution|HD-720|
|resolution|HD-1080|
|resolution|HD-4K|
|resolution|External|
|resolution|Unknown|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the page.|
|isStatic|boolean|true|none|True if this page is static and doesn't have any dynamic content to load.<br><br>Static pages don't need to go back to the page endpoint to load page content<br>instead the page summary loaded with the sitemap should be enough to determine<br>the page template type and render based on this.<br>|
|isSystemPage|boolean|true|none|True if this page is a system page type.<br><br>**DEPRECATED** This property doesn't have any real use in client applications<br>anymore so shouldn't be used. It especially shouldn't be used to determine if<br>a page is static or not. Use the `isStatic` property instead.<br>|
|key|string|false|none|Key used to lookup a known page.|
|path|string|true|none|Unique path for the page.|
|template|string|true|none|Identifier for of the page template to render this page.|
|title|string|true|none|Title of the page.|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for a page.|
|entries|[[PageEntry](#schemapageentry)]|true|none|Entries of a page|
|item|[ItemDetail](#schemaitemdetail)|false|none|none|
|list|[ItemList](#schemaitemlist)|false|none|A pageable list of items.|
|metadata|[PageMetadata](#schemapagemetadata)|false|none|Metadata associated with a page. Primarily intended for SEO usage.|
|themes|[[Theme](#schematheme)]|false|none|none|

Represents an entry of a Page.
Defines what specific piece of content should be presented e.g. an Item or ItemList.
Also defines what visual template should be used to render that content.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customFields|object|false|none|A map of custom fields defined by a curator for a page entry.|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for a page entry.|
|images|object|false|none|The images for the page entry if any.<br><br>For example the images of an `ImageEntry`.<br>|
|item|[ItemSummary](#schemaitemsummary)|false|none|none|
|list|[ItemList](#schemaitemlist)|false|none|A pageable list of items.|
|people|[[Person](#schemaperson)]|false|none|If 'type' is 'PeopleEntry' then this is the array of people to present.|
|template|string|true|none|Template type used to present the content of the PageEntry.|
|text|string|false|none|If 'type' is 'TextEntry' then this is the text to be represented.|
|title|string|true|none|The name of the Page Entry.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of PageEntry. Used to help identify what type of content will be presented.|

|segments|[string]|false|none|The segments a profile should be placed under|

{

  },

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authorizationDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the purchase was authorized.|
|creationDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the purchase was created.|
|currency|string|true|none|The currency code used to make the purchase.|
|id|string|true|none|The identifier of the purchase.|
|item|[ItemPurchase](#schemaitempurchase)|false|none|none|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The identifier of the payment method used to make the purchase.|
|plan|[PlanPurchase](#schemaplanpurchase)|false|none|none|
|total|number(float)|true|none|The total cost of the purchase.|

<h2 id="tocS_PurchaseRequest">PurchaseRequest</h2>

<a id="tocspurchaserequest"></a>

```json
{
  "itemId": "string",
  "offerId": "string",
  "paymentMethodId": "string",
  "planId": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|false|none|The identifier of the item to purchase.<br>Both `itemId` and `offerId` are required for item purchases.<br>|
|offerId|string|false|none|The identifier of the item offer to purchase.<br>Both `itemId` and `offerId` are required for item purchases.<br>|
|paymentMethodId|string|false|none|The identifier of the payment method to use.<br>If omitted, or if purchasing a plan, the default payment method will be used.<br>|
|planId|string|false|none|The identifier of the plan to purchase.|

  "productCode": "string",
  "savingLabel": "string",
  "trialPeriodDays": 0
}

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|number(float)|true|none|The price of a plan. If a free plan then undefined.|
|currency|string|true|none|The currency a plan is offered in.|
|description|string|true|none|The textual description.|
|interval|string|true|none|The type of billing period used.|
|intervalCount|integer(int32)|true|none|Given the `interval` this is how frequently it will run. e.g. every 2 weeks.|
|nickname|string|true|none|The title of a plan.|
|product|string|true|none|The product of a plan.|
|productCode|string|true|none|The identifier of a plan.|
|savingLabel|string|true|none|NA.|
|trialPeriodDays|integer(int32)|true|none|How many days a trial period runs for a plan. Only valid if `hasTrialPeriod` is true.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|interval|day|
|interval|week|
|interval|month|
|interval|year|
|interval|none|

|image_url|string(uri)|true|none|Thumbnail image URL|
|is_playable|boolean|true|none|If "true", a "Play" icon is shown over the thumbnail image|
|position|integer(int32)|false|none|Section position. If specified, sections are shown in ascending position order|
|subtitle|string|false|none|Tile subtitle|
|title|string|false|none|Tile title|

<h2 id="tocS_SingleSignOnRequest">SingleSignOnRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasinglesignonrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_SingleSignOnRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSsinglesignonrequest"></a>
<a id="tocssinglesignonrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "cookieType": "Session",
  "linkAccounts": true,
  "provider": "Facebook",
  "scopes": [
    "Catalog"
  ],
  "token": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cookieType|string|false|none|If you specify a cookie type then a content filter cookie will be returned<br>along with the token(s). This is only intended for web based clients which<br>need to pass the cookies to a server to render a page based on the user's<br>content filters e.g subscription code.<br><br>If type `Session` the cookie will be session based.<br>If type `Persistent` the cookie will have a medium term lifespan.<br>If undefined no cookies will be set.<br>|
|linkAccounts|boolean|false|none|When a user attempts to sign in using single-sign-on, we may find an account created<br>previously through the manual sign up flow with the same email. If this is the<br>case then an option to link the two accounts can be made available.<br><br>If this flag is set to true then accounts will be linked automatically.<br><br>If this flag is not set or set to false and an existing account is found <br>then an http 401 with subcode `6001` will be returned. Client apps can then present the<br>option to link the accounts. If the user decides to accept, then the same call<br>can be repeated with this flag set to true.<br>|
|provider|string|true|none|The third party single-sign-on provider.|
|scopes|[string]|false|none|The scope(s) of the tokens required.<br>For each scope listed an Account and Profile token of that scope will be returned.<br>|
|token|string|true|none|A token from the third party single-sign-on provider e.g. an identity token from Facebook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|cookieType|Session|
|cookieType|Persistent|
|provider|Facebook|
|scopes|Catalog|
|scopes|Commerce|
|scopes|Settings|
|scopes|Playback|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|endDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The end date of a subscription.<br><br>After this date the subscription will become expired. If this is a recurring<br>subscription which has not been cancelled then the account holder will be<br>automatically charged and a new subscription will be activated.<br><br>Some subscriptions may not have an end date, in which case this<br>property will not exist.<br>|
|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the subscription.|
|isTrialPeriod|boolean|true|none|True if a subscription is in its trial period, false if not.|
|planId|string|true|none|The plan a subscription belongs to.|
|startDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The start date of a subscription.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of a subscription.|

|status|Cancelled|

|status|None|
